message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a dark blue background and a red bar at the top left. The title "TEMPO" appears in large white serif font above the text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". On the right, a man with red-tinted skin and a dark green uniform leans forward, peering through a black magnifying glass held in his right hand. His left hand is clenched into a fist. To his left is a large, dark blue silhouette of a person holding a long-barreled firearm, which casts a diagonal shadow toward the uniformed man's feet. A red glow emanates from the bottom right corner.

Legible text includes "Ragu-ragu Oposisi PDI Perjuangan H. 30", "Penyimpangan Dana Indofarma H. 86", and "DETASEMEN KHUSUS URUSAN KASUS". A paragraph mentions "Penguntitan Jaksa Agung Muda Febrie Adriansyah oleh personel Detasemen Khusus 88" and "korupsi tata niaga timah." The bottom left displays "3-9 JUNI 2024", "RP 50.000", "ISSN: 0126 - 4273", a barcode, and a QR code.
